title: RS3 Equilibrium asset provenance catalog shard
description: Durable provenance for one domain of assets/. Rows are sorted by id. Never records resolved download URLs, hashes, or timestamps - those belong to .asset-cache/, which is not tracked.

id.description: Stable identifier. Unique across every shard.

category.description: Mirrors the directory under assets/, minus the filename. Decides the shard.

path.description: Local path WITHOUT an extension - the extension follows the file on disk.

fileTitle.description: Exact RuneScape Wiki File: title when known.

aliases.description: Retired ids that resolved to this same artwork.

provenanceAlternates.description: Merged historical rows, kept so a past attribution is still traceable.

provenance.description: Set only when no upstream source could be established. Never invent one.

publish.description: Extra public paths this one file serves, beyond its routed target.
